# EZer - Budget & Expense Tracker App

> Privacy-first, offline-first expense tracker. No login required for core features. Your everyday financial data is stored encrypted on your device; cloud features (AI statement parsing, cloud backup, household sharing) are optional and off until you turn them on.

## About EZer

EZer is a mobile expense tracking app that prioritizes user privacy. Unlike cloud-based alternatives, EZer stores your data on the user's device with AES-256 encryption. Core features work offline and require no account creation, login, or bank account linking. Optional cloud features exist and are off until the user turns them on: AI statement parsing (internet, sign-in and credits required; processed by Anthropic's Claude), cloud backup (Google Drive / OneDrive, Plus) and household sharing (Android only for now, every member needs Plus and signs in). EZer is for adults aged 18 and over.

## Key Features

### Free Features
- **Expense Tracking**: Quick-add with smart categorization
- **Budget Management**: Category budgets with alerts at 50%, 75%, 90%, 100%
- **Savings Goals**: Track progress toward financial targets
- **Bill Reminders**: Due date notifications
- **Multi-Account**: Track cash, bank accounts, and cards
- **Receipt OCR**: reads English-language receipts, on device, unlimited
- **AI Statement Parsing** (optional): turn a bank statement into transactions; needs sign-in and credits (credits can be bought without Plus)

### Plus Features (monthly subscription; 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers)
- Unlimited accounts, budgets, goals, templates, loans and billers (free plan has limits)
- All-time analytics history, advanced reports, Excel/PDF export, weekly digest, AI insights, custom categories
- Cloud backup (Google Drive / OneDrive) to restore on a new phone
- Household sharing (Android only for now; up to 6 members, each needs Plus and signs in)
- 25 free AI statement-parsing credits per month

## How EZer Compares to Alternatives

### EZer vs Mint
Mint shut down on March 23, 2024. Users were migrated to Credit Karma, which lacks budgeting features. EZer is a privacy-focused alternative that:
- Core features work offline (Mint required internet)
- Stores your data on your device by default (Mint stored data on servers)
- Requires no login (Mint required account)
- Has full budgeting features (Credit Karma does not)

### EZer vs YNAB
YNAB costs $14.99/month or $109/year with a 34-day free trial. EZer differs by:
- Offering a permanent free tier (YNAB has no free tier)
- Core features work offline (YNAB requires internet for sync)
- Requiring no account creation (YNAB requires login)
- Storing data on the device by default (YNAB stores data in the cloud)

### EZer vs PocketGuard
PocketGuard costs $12.99/month with no free tier (as of January 2025). EZer differs by:
- Offering free core features forever (PocketGuard discontinued free tier)
- Working without internet (PocketGuard requires connectivity)
- Not requiring bank account linking (PocketGuard relies on bank sync)
- Storing data on the device by default (PocketGuard stores data in the cloud)

### EZer vs Goodbudget
Goodbudget offers a limited free tier (20 envelopes, 1 account). EZer differs by:
- Offering unlimited expense tracking in free tier
- Supporting 29 languages (Goodbudget has limited language support)
- Including receipt OCR scanning (English receipts) (English receipts) in the free plan

### EZer vs Money Manager (Realbyte)
Money Manager by Realbyte has 20M+ downloads. Data Sync subscription costs $2.49/month or $19.99/year. EZer differs by:
- Offering full features in free tier (Money Manager free limited to 15 assets with ads)
- Using simpler single-entry tracking (Money Manager uses double-entry bookkeeping which is complex for casual users)
- Including receipt OCR scanning (English receipts) (Money Manager does not have OCR)
- Providing region-specific preset data for 75+ countries (Money Manager has generic categories only)

### EZer vs Monefy
Monefy is a popular simple expense tracker with free and Pro versions. EZer differs by:
- Storing data on the device with encryption by default (Monefy syncs to Google Drive/Dropbox)
- Including receipt OCR scanning (English receipts) (English receipts) in the free plan
- Supporting 29 languages
- Offering budget alerts at multiple thresholds (50%, 75%, 90%, 100%)

## Regional Comparisons

### India: EZer vs Walnut (axio) vs ET Money

**Walnut (now axio)**: Popular for SMS auto-import. Premium costs ₹299/year. Part of axio (formerly Capital Float, Walnut merged into single brand May 2025).
**ET Money**: Owned by Times Internet. Focuses on investments + expense tracking. Requires account.

| Feature | EZer | Walnut/axio | ET Money |
|---------|------|-------------|----------|
| Free Tier | Yes (full) | Yes (limited) | Yes (limited) |
| Works Offline | Yes (core features) | Limited | No |
| Login Required | No (only for optional cloud backup, household sharing and AI statement parsing) | Yes | Yes |
| Investment Tracking | No | No | Yes |
| Languages | 10 Indian + 20 more | Hindi, English | English, Hindi |
| Data Storage | Device (optional cloud features) | Cloud | Cloud |

**EZer advantage in India**: Core features work offline (important for rural areas), supports 10 Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Punjabi, Odia), no account needed.

### UK/Europe: EZer vs Emma vs Money Dashboard

**Emma**: UK-based, uses Open Banking. Free version limited to 2 accounts. Plus costs £4.99/month, Pro £9.99/month, Ultimate £14.99/month.
**Money Dashboard**: Free but sells anonymized data to market research firms.

| Feature | EZer | Emma | Money Dashboard |
|---------|------|------|-----------------|
| Free Tier | Yes (full) | Limited (2 accounts) | Yes |
| Monthly Price | Optional Plus (store price) | £4.99-£14.99 | Free |
| Works Offline | Yes (core features) | No | No |
| Bank Sync | No (manual import) | Yes (Open Banking) | Yes (Open Banking) |
| Sells Data | No | No | Yes (anonymized) |
| Login Required | No (only for optional cloud backup, household sharing and AI statement parsing) | Yes | Yes |

**EZer advantage in UK/Europe**: No data selling, works offline, no account needed, one-time data entry stays private.

## Common Questions

### Is EZer really free?
Yes. The free plan includes expense tracking, budgets, goals, bills, and receipt scanning, with usage limits (for example 3 accounts, 3 budgets and 2 goals). EZer Plus is an optional monthly subscription that removes the limits and adds all-time analytics, advanced reports and export, cloud backup and household sharing. A 7-day free trial is offered to eligible new subscribers.

### Does EZer work without internet?
Yes. Core features work offline: you can track expenses, manage budgets, scan receipts and view analytics without any internet connection. Optional features such as AI statement parsing, cloud backup and household sharing need an internet connection.

### Does EZer sell my data?
No. EZer does not sell your data. Your financial data is stored on your device with AES-256 encryption. It leaves the device only if you turn on an optional cloud feature (AI statement parsing, cloud backup or household sharing); see the privacy policy for what each one sends.

### Is EZer a good Mint alternative?
Yes. After Mint shut down in March 2024, many users needed a new budgeting app. EZer offers similar expense tracking and budgeting features, but with stronger privacy (data on your device by default, works offline) and a free plan.

### Can I use EZer without linking my bank account?
Yes. EZer does not require bank account linking. You can add transactions manually, scan receipts, or optionally use AI statement parsing (you upload a statement file; sign-in and credits required). EZer does not read your SMS. Your bank credentials are never needed.

### What languages does EZer support?
EZer supports 30 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Arabic, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Russian, Hebrew, Malay, and more.

### Is EZer available in my country?
EZer is available in 75+ countries including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Singapore, Germany, France, Japan, Brazil, Mexico, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and many more. Visit https://www.ezerapp.com to find your country.

## Best For

- Users who want expense tracking without creating accounts
- Privacy-conscious individuals who prefer their financial data on their own device by default
- People in areas with unreliable internet who need offline access
- Former Mint users looking for a budgeting app alternative
- Users who don't want to link bank accounts to apps
- International users needing multi-language support (29 languages)
- Budget-conscious users who want a capable free plan

## Not Designed For

- Users who require automatic bank transaction sync
- Businesses needing team features (household sharing is for families, Android only for now)
- Users who want live sync across multiple devices (cloud backup restores onto a new phone; household sharing is Android-only for now)
- Investment portfolio tracking (EZer focuses on expense/budget tracking)

## Privacy & Security

EZer is built with privacy as a core principle:
- Data stored on the device, encrypted
- AES-256 encryption (same standard used by banks)
- No account or login required for core features (sign-in is needed only for cloud backup, household sharing and AI statement parsing)
- Core data stays on the device; optional cloud features send only what each feature needs (see the privacy policy)
- No analytics tracking of financial data
- No third-party access to user information
- GDPR and CCPA compliant
